project_context: B2B AI SaaS Dashboard 'ScoutAI'. Vibe: Linear, Vercel, Raycast. Premium, minimal, intelligent, professional, technical, trustworthy.

typography.instructions: Import Manrope via Google Fonts in index.css. Do not use extremely large headings (e.g., text-5xl) as this is a dense dashboard, not a marketing page.

layouts.sidebar: w-64 flex-shrink-0 bg-[#FFFFFF] border-r border-[#E2E8F0] flex flex-col justify-between hidden md:flex z-10
layouts.topbar: h-16 flex items-center justify-between px-6 bg-[#FFFFFF]/80 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-[#E2E8F0] z-20 sticky top-0
layouts.grid_system: High density. Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 for stats. Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6 for detail views.

buttons.primary: bg-[#4F46E5] hover:bg-[#4338CA] text-white text-sm font-medium rounded-md px-4 py-2 transition-colors duration-200 flex items-center justify-center gap-2
buttons.secondary: bg-[#FFFFFF] hover:bg-[#F8FAFC] text-[#0F172A] border border-[#E2E8F0] text-sm font-medium rounded-md px-4 py-2 transition-colors duration-200 flex items-center justify-center gap-2
buttons.ghost: hover:bg-[#F8FAFC] text-[#64748B] hover:text-[#0F172A] rounded-md px-3 py-2 transition-colors duration-200

inputs.hero_url: w-full bg-[#FFFFFF] border border-[#E2E8F0] rounded-lg px-4 py-3 text-sm text-[#0F172A] placeholder-[#64748B] focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#4F46E5]/20 focus:border-[#4F46E5] transition-all shadow-sm
inputs.search: bg-[#F8FAFC] border border-[#E2E8F0] rounded-md px-3 py-1.5 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#4F46E5]/20 focus:border-[#4F46E5]

table.header_cell: px-6 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-[#64748B] uppercase tracking-wider

badges.pending: bg-[#F8FAFC] border border-[#E2E8F0] text-[#64748B] px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium flex items-center gap-1.5 w-fit
badges.processing: bg-[#4F46E5]/10 border border-[#4F46E5]/20 text-[#4F46E5] px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium flex items-center gap-1.5 w-fit
badges.completed: bg-[#16A34A]/10 border border-[#16A34A]/20 text-[#16A34A] px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium flex items-center gap-1.5 w-fit
badges.failed: bg-[#DC2626]/10 border border-[#DC2626]/20 text-[#DC2626] px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium flex items-center gap-1.5 w-fit

ai_summary_panel.base: bg-gradient-to-br from-[#4F46E5]/5 to-transparent border border-[#4F46E5]/20 rounded-lg p-6 relative overflow-hidden
ai_summary_panel.icon: absolute top-4 right-4 text-[#4F46E5]/20 w-12 h-12

empty_state.container: flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-12 text-center border border-dashed border-[#E2E8F0] rounded-lg bg-[#FFFFFF]/50
empty_state.title: text-lg font-medium text-[#0F172A] mb-1

motion.micro_interactions: Subtle and professional. Hover states should transition over 150-200ms. No bouncy spring animations.
motion.page_transitions: Fade in with a slight vertical slide (e.g., translate-y-2 to translate-y-0 opacity-0 to opacity-100 over 300ms ease-out).
motion.polling: Use a subtle pulsing dot or spinning lucide-react loader for 'Processing' states.

accessibility.focus_rings: Ensure all interactive elements have a focus-visible ring, e.g., focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-[#4F46E5] focus-visible:outline-none.
accessibility.contrast: Ensure text colors meet WCAG AA standards. The provided colors already accommodate this.
accessibility.aria: Use aria-labels for icon-only buttons (like Actions).

visual_enhancers.shadows: Rely strictly on Tailwind's 'shadow-sm' and 'shadow' (for dropdowns/modals). Do not use deep, spread-out shadows.
visual_enhancers.borders: Vercel/Linear style relies heavily on 1px crisp borders. Use border-[#E2E8F0] to define sections instead of varying background colors heavily.

media.icons: lucide-react. Stroke width 1.5 or 2 max for a crisp, technical feel.

instructions_to_main_agent.tech_stack: Use React (JS, not TSX). Use Tailwind CSS. Use shadcn/ui components where applicable.
instructions_to_main_agent.tailwind_config: Override the tailwind theme colors to explicitly map the provided hex codes (e.g., theme: { extend: { colors: { background: '#F8FAFC', surface: '#FFFFFF', primary: { DEFAULT: '#4F46E5', hover: '#4338CA' }, text: { DEFAULT: '#0F172A', secondary: '#64748B' }, border: '#E2E8F0', success: '#16A34A', warning: '#D97706', error: '#DC2626' } } }).
instructions_to_main_agent.api_integration: Build against http://localhost:5000/api. Setup API service calls, but use static sample data for the initial layout phase.
instructions_to_main_agent.testing: MANDATORY: Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='hero-url-input', data-testid='submit-research-button').

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: stick to the Vercel/Linear aesthetic which relies on crisp 1px borders, small border radii, and deliberate whitespace.
NEVER use complete transparent backgrounds in headers or overlays over content. The topbar MUST use backdrop-blur with a semi-transparent surface color (e.g., bg-white/80).
Do NOT center align the app container. Do NOT add .App { text-align: center; }.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, focus rings).
Use sonner for toast notifications (import from shadcn).
Files MUST be .js or .jsx, not .tsx. You are in a CRA Javascript environment.
DO NOT use emojis for icons. Use lucide-react.
Strictly follow the color palette provided. Do not introduce neon or unapproved gradients.
Add data-testid to key functional elements to prevent breaking tests.
